function.name: search_product_service
function.description: This  allows users to search for restaurants, products, or services, which may expose user preferences and previous interactions.

search_query.description: The search term entered by the user, such as a restaurant name, product, or service type.

user_location.description: The user's current location to provide relevant search results based on proximity.

function.name: place_order
function.description: This  enables users to place an order for food or services, involving sensitive user data such as chosen items and delivery details.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user placing the order.

order_items.description: A list of items or services being ordered, including quantities and specific preferences.

delivery_address.description: The address where the order will be delivered.

function.name: pay_order
function.description: This  processes the payment for the user's order, handling financial information and order details securely.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user making the payment.

order_id.description: The unique identifier for the order being paid for.

payment_method.description: The payment method chosen by the user (e.g., credit card, mobile wallet, etc.).

function.name: view_order_history
function.description: This  allows users to retrieve their past order history, which may expose their consumption patterns and preferences.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user whose order history is being requested.

page_number.description: The page number for paginated results.

page_size.description: The number of records to retrieve per page.

function.name: manage_address
function.description: This  allows users to add or modify their delivery addresses, which involves sensitive information such as home or office addresses.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user managing the address.

address.description: The address to be added or updated.

function.name: rate_merchant_service
function.description: This  enables users to rate and provide feedback on merchants or services, potentially exposing personal experience and preferences.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user submitting the rating.

merchant_id.description: Unique identifier for the merchant or service being rated.

rating.description: The rating given by the user, typically a value between 1 and 5.

comments.description: Optional textual feedback from the user regarding their experience.

function.name: redeem_coupon
function.description: This  allows users to redeem discount coupons when making payments, involving sensitive financial information and promotional data.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user redeeming the coupon.

coupon_code.description: The unique code for the coupon being redeemed.

order_id.description: The ID of the order for which the coupon is being applied.
